title: Alternative Andesite Crafting
description: A small Minecraft datapack that adds alternative crafting recipes for andesite.
body:
# A small Minecraft datapack that adds alternative crafting recipes for andesite.

**Craft Andesite from**

- Cobblestone and Gravel
- Cobblestone and Granite

![Andesite](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e181f2107fdb53390037a8b73f7a17846ceea916.png)

**Supported Version**

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1

**Installation**

1. Download the datapack
2. Place it into:
    ```
    .minecraft/saves/<your_world>/datapacks
    ```
3. Done!
